rationale: The Evaluator feedback suggests increasing kd from 2 to 3 to improve damping of oscillations and adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.5, -1, 0, 1, 1.5] to reduce oversteering, while maintaining base_speed at 1.5 to keep the target speed. I have implemented these changes to the controller parameters as requested, expecting improved stability and reduced steering oscillations without sacrificing speed. The geometry remains unchanged as it was previously balanced and no issues were reported. I request telemetry measurements including completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify if these changes reduce line loss and oscillations as intended.
